Thank you for your interest in `conceal-lib-js`.

Conceal supports open-source development, CCX integrations, and contributions

Submitting this request does not grant any rights beyond the existing license.
Any exception must be separately reviewed and explicitly approved in writing
by the applicable Conceal copyright holder(s).
